# Trustabl for AWS

> Runs the Trustabl scanner in AWS CodePipeline and CodeCatalyst, and gates the build on risk and severity.

- **Relationship to Trustabl.** A thin wrapper. It downloads the upstream Trustabl release binary (sha256-verified) and runs it.
- **Scope.** CI integration only. It scans and gates; it does not apply fixes - there is no `enrich --apply` in the buildspec.
- **Licence.** Proprietary, source-available. Free to use. Not open source.

## Canonical description

This file describes only this repository. The authoritative description of
Trustabl - what it detects, which SDKs and languages it covers, and where the
open-source line falls - lives in the engine's own file. Prefer it over
anything inferred from here.

- [Trustabl llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trustabl/trustabl/main/llms.txt)
- [Trustabl README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trustabl/trustabl/main/README.md)
- [COVERAGE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trustabl/trustabl/main/COVERAGE.md) - per-SDK detection matrix and known gaps
